messages.subject: hydrostats package
parts:
Does anyone have experience using the hydrostats package (https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/hydrostats/index.html)?  I'm wondering if it's calculations are accurate, and rather than wade through the pages of package code, I thought I'd check here first.  Thanks in advance!

Meghan

messages.author: 0c0915d54307a5d8
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: hydrostats package
parts:
I've played with it a little, but did not go into great depths with it. I certainly didn't wade through all the code. However, all the values it gave were logical, and the documentation seemed based on good literature. I'm not a hydrologist, so take anything I say about it with a grain of salt.

In general, if I'm going to use a package for anything important I like to wade through enough of the code/documentation/literature so I understand what they are doing. It's painful, but I always learn more in the end.
